items.prompt: What does continue do inside this Python for-loop?
items.explanation: continue skips the remainder of this iteration and lets the loop proceed. It does not exit the whole function or undo an earlier update.

options.text: It exits the whole loop and prevents later iterations
It restarts the function with its original arguments
options.why: continue changes loop control, not function invocation.

options.text: It reverses every state change made in the iteration
options.why: There is no automatic rollback of earlier assignments.

options.text: It skips the rest of the current iteration
options.why: Later iterations can still run if input remains.
